feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day shipping forecast

items.title: 5 day shipping forecast updated as of 1 June 2026 4:12am
items.description:
##Today##


##Warnings)##

Strong winds in the south until later.


##Wind)##

S-SW 4 or 5, increasing 6 in the south at times, decreasing 2 to 4 later this evening, becoming variable in places later.


##State of sea)##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later.


##Weather)##

Occasional rain or drizzle as well as areas of mist, with isolated fog patches.


##Visibility)##

Moderate or poor and falling very poor in fog patches.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 15°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C
##Tomorrow##


##Warnings)##

Nil.


##Wind)##

W or SW 2 to 4, increasing 4 or 5 later.


##State of sea)##

Slight, occasionally moderate in the south later.


##Weather)##

Showery outbreaks of rain soon clearing to isolated showers.


##Visibility)##

Good, falling moderate in rain or showers.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 12°C and max. air temperature 17°C
##Sea Temperature##

12°C

##Visibility)##

12°C
